article.title: Are economics students happier?  One estimation from Germany
article.excerpt: Michael Tamada sent me notice of a recent study , by Justus Haucap and Ulrich Heimeshoff: A pair of German economists note that while scholars in their field have vigorously begun analyzing the economics of happiness, no one has studied the happiness of economists themselves.
